ev.q: During 2004--2008, 20.5% of adults aged ≥18 years were current cigarette smokers.
SOURCE: Barnes PM, Adams PF, Powell-Griner E. Health characteristics of the American Indian and Alaska Native adult population

methods_quotes.q: Estimates are age adjusted using the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population
Unknowns were not included in the denominators when calculating percentages.
